title: AndroidAPS 3.2 dev hangs after pressing NSClientV3 "switch on" button
symptom: When trying to activate the NSClientV3 option in the Configurator, the button turns gray but the app hangs and becomes unresponsive. Restarting the app, clearing cache, and restarting the phone do not help.
cause: The issue was an Android-specific problem, likely a bug in the app that was fixed by a commit.
fix: Updating to a build that includes commit 2b89a78102afa47cf7d4a3b0a771facd74293ec1 resolved the problem.
evidence_quote: With this update the problem is solved.
